rg -n 'BROWSER|executable|channel' scripts/browser-smoke.mjs
Test-Path -LiteralPath 'C:/Program Files/Google/Chrome/Application/chrome.exe'

rg --files 'C:/Users/offic/.cache/codex-runtimes' -g chrome.exe -g chrome-headless-shell.exe -g msedge.exe
